hints: Express driving force in terms of engine power $P$ and speed using $F = \frac{P}{v}$.
Form Newton's second law at $A$ ($v = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$): $\frac{P}{20} - 6000 = 15000a$.
Form Newton's second law at $B$ ($v = 25\text{ m s}^{-1}$): $\frac{P}{25} - 6000 = 15000(0.5a) = 7500a$.
Eliminate $a$ to show $P = 200\text{ kW}$, then evaluate $a = \frac{4}{15}\text{ m s}^{-2}$.
walkthrough:
Relate the engine power $P$, driving force $F_D$, and velocity $v$:
$$P = F_D v \implies F_D = \frac{P}{v}$$

Apply Newton's second law $F_{\text{net}} = ma$ horizontally at point $A$ where $v = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and acceleration is $a$:
$$\frac{P}{20} - 6000 = 15000a\quad \text{(Equation 1)}$$

Apply Newton's second law horizontally at point $B$ where $v = 25\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and acceleration is $0.5a$:
$$\frac{P}{25} - 6000 = 15000(0.5a) = 7500a\quad \text{(Equation 2)}$$

Multiply Equation 2 by 2 to match the right-hand side of Equation 1:
$$2\left(\frac{P}{25} - 6000\right) = 15000a$$
$$\frac{2P}{25} - 12000 = 15000a$$

Add 12000 to both sides and subtract $\frac{P}{20}$:
$$\frac{2P}{25} - \frac{P}{20} = 6000$$

Find a common denominator of 100:
$$\frac{8P - 5P}{100} = 6000$$
$$\frac{3P}{100} = 6000$$
$$3P = 600000 \implies P = 200000\text{ W} = 200\text{ kW}$$

Substitute $P = 200000\text{ W}$ back into Equation 1 to find acceleration $a$ at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$:
$$\frac{200000}{20} - 6000 = 15000a$$
$$10000 - 6000 = 15000a$$
$$4000 = 15000a$$
$$a = \frac{4000}{15000} = \frac{4}{15}\text{ m s}^{-2}\quad (\approx 0.267\text{ m s}^{-2})$$

hints: At steady speed up the $1^\circ$ hill, acceleration is zero, so the driving force balances both the $6000\text{ N}$ resistance and the component of weight down the slope.
walkthrough:
State the condition for steady speed up the slope: when speed is constant, acceleration is zero ($a = 0\text{ m s}^{-2}$). The forward driving force $F = \frac{P}{v}$ must balance both the resistance force and the component of weight acting down the incline:
$$\frac{P}{v} - R - mg\sin 1^\circ = 0$$

Divide 200000 by 8617.86 to solve for $v$:
$$v = \frac{200000}{8617.86} \approx 23.2076\text{ m s}^{-1}$$
$$v = 23.2\text{ m s}^{-1}\quad (\text{to 3 significant figures})$$
